headline: In a controlled test across 4 models, adding a confident wrong diagnosis reduced accuracy from 61/68 to 42/68 (27.9 percentage points). Each comparison used the same report, with only the comment changed.

l3_quote.reason: The report shows a value magnitude error consistent with unit conversion issues, and the developer confirmed the fix for #2511 is failing.

caveats: Pooled headline uses first runs only.
Wilson intervals are descriptive binomial intervals; shared-case/model dependence is not modeled.
Paired differences are observed contrasts, not independent-arm significance tests.
L1 to L3 combines confidence and authority.
At L0/P, followed means choosing the counterfactual wrong target ID.
